criteria.requirement: Five assessment axes consume fixed PSI-46 coordinates; no new version grammar or dimension is created.
Specification assessment requires an explicit consumer-supported range and PSI-47 evaluator result.
Contract version remains opaque; contract definition/change evidence, not version ordering, determines compatibility.
Runtime and protocol compatibility require explicit profiles, mapping and evidence.
Governance outcomes are bounded by M5 authority and evidence.
Only four outcomes exist; aggregation is deterministic and missing evidence is never compatible.
Reports preserve exact subject/consumer coordinates and deterministic canonical content.
